primitives: Lathed spindle body; dorsal, anal, paired pectoral and pelvic fins as tapered quads; caudal fin by tail_type
parameters: length, girth_ratio (0.15-0.35), head_ratio (0.2-0.35), tail_type (forked/rounded/lunate/pointed), dorsal_count (1-2), fin_scale, eye_size, mouth (small/under/gape)
animation: Traveling sine along the spine, amplitude rising to the tail; pectorals sweep on turns; gill flare on attack
examples: Sardine, barracuda, tuna, grouper, wrasse

primitives: Lathed body squashed sideways (girth_z 0.3 x girth_y); tall dorsal and anal fins; small caudal
parameters: length, height_ratio (0.5-0.9), fin_height, eye_size, stripe_count
animation: Body rocks side to side rather than sweeping; fins flutter
examples: Angelfish, butterflyfish, triggerfish, surgeonfish, cardinalfish

primitives: A tube swept along a spline of 12-24 segments; continuous fin ribbon; no pectorals (eels) or none at all (worms)
parameters: length, segments, girth_ratio (0.04-0.12), fin_ribbon (bool), head (eel/worm/lure), jaw_hinge
animation: Full-body undulation with 1.5-2.5 wavelengths; a strike straightens the front half in 0.2 s
examples: Moray, conger, cave eel, oarfish, bobbit worm, ghost worm, the Wyrm

primitives: A flattened disc (lathed ellipse, girth_y 0.1) with wing edges; a whip or paddle tail
parameters: span, disc_shape (round/diamond/kite), tail_type (whip/paddle/none), eye_top (bool), barb (bool)
animation: Wing-edge wave front to back; rests by settling into silt with a particle puff
examples: Stingray, manta, whip ray, electric ray, deep skate, flounder

primitives: Fusiform with a heterocercal tail, 5-7 gill slits as ink lines, pointed snout, triangular dorsal
parameters: length, girth_ratio, snout (pointed/blunt/hammer/goblin/frilled), dorsal_size, gill_slits, tail_upper_ratio
animation: Stiff-body sine (low amplitude), tail does the work; rolls the eye on bite; pectorals drop as a threat display
examples: Bull, tiger, hammerhead, sixgill, goblin, blacktip, nurse

primitives: A domed shell (lathed hemisphere with plate ink lines) over a flattened body; four flippers or legs; retractable head
parameters: length, dome_height, plate_pattern (scute/leather), limb (flipper/leg), neck_length, beak (bool)
animation: Alternating flipper strokes; head retracts on hit; shell is the armored front
examples: Green, hawksbill, loggerhead, leatherback, hadal, snapping

primitives: Long jaw (two hinged wedges), armored back (rows of scute quads), four splayed legs, a tapering tail
parameters: length, jaw_ratio (0.2-0.3), scute_rows, leg_length, tail_ratio, eye_ridge
animation: Lateral tail sculling in water; sprawling gait on land; death roll is a full-body spin about the spine
examples: Saltwater crocodile, Nile crocodile, cave caiman, pale caiman, water monitor

primitives: Anguilliform with a paddle tail, distinct head, and banding ink
parameters: length, band_count, head_ratio, paddle_tail (bool)
animation: Undulation; coils before a strike (S-curve), then straightens
examples: Banded, olive, cave, temple, abyssal snakes

primitives: A carapace (lathed dome or box), 8 legs of 2-3 segments on IK, 2 claws (lobster/crab) or none (isopod); antennae chains
parameters: width, carapace_shape (round/box/segmented), claw_size, leg_length, antenna_length, spines (bool), decoration (bool)
animation: Sideways walk on IK legs; claws raise as a tell; isopods roll into a ball
examples: Fiddler, hermit, spider crab, lobsters, isopods, the Lobster

primitives: Segmented arched body of 6-8 lathed rings; fan tail; long antennae chains; raptorial arms (mantis)
parameters: length, segments, arch, antenna_length, raptorial (bool), transparency
animation: Tail flicks propel backward; mantis punch is a 2-frame snap
examples: Cleaner shrimp, glass shrimp, mantis shrimp, krill, amphipods

primitives: A mantle (lathed egg or cone), a head with two large eyes, 8 arm chains (plus 2 tentacle chains for squid), fins (squid/cuttlefish)
parameters: mantle_length, mantle_shape (egg/cone/round), arm_length, arm_count, fin (bool), eye_size, chromatophore (bool)
animation: Arms are Chains driven by the body; jet pulse compresses the mantle; chromatophore flash is a palette pulse
examples: Octopus, squid, cuttlefish, blue-ring, dumbo, colossal squid

primitives: A bell (lathed hemisphere, translucent material) and tentacle chains; siphonophores are a chain of bells
parameters: bell_diameter, tentacle_count, tentacle_length, translucency, bell_count (siphonophore)
animation: Bell pulse (squash then stretch); tentacles trail as Chains
examples: Box jelly, moon jelly, man o' war, deep jelly, siphonophore, anemones

primitives: A broad head with a hinged jaw, four legs (frogs: long hind), smooth skin material; tail (newts, salamanders) or none (frogs)
parameters: length, head_width, leg_type (frog/salamander), tail (bool), gills_external (bool), skin (smooth/warty)
animation: Frog: sit, then leap; salamander: lateral gait; tongue is a fast Chain extension
examples: Toad, frogs, newts, olm, giant salamander, lab salamander, axolotl

primitives: Fusiform mammal with a blunt head, whisker ink, two front flippers and joined hind flippers
parameters: length, girth_ratio (0.3-0.4), whiskers (bool), bull_nose (bool)
animation: Rolling swim with front-flipper strokes; hauls out with a belly hop
examples: Monk seal, elephant seal

primitives: Fusiform mammal with a horizontal fluke, a blowhole, dorsal fin, pectoral paddles
parameters: length, girth_ratio, dorsal (tall/curved/none), fluke_span, melon (bool), head (beak/blunt/block), patch_pattern (orca)
animation: Vertical (up-down) sine unlike fish; breaches; clicks are a head-shake particle burst
examples: Dolphin, humpback, sperm whale, the Matriarch

primitives: A segmented body of 2-3 lathed segments, 6 (insect) or 8 (spider) IK legs, optional wings (quads), antennae
parameters: length, segments, legs (6/8), wings (bool), leg_span, abdomen_ratio
animation: Leg-cycle walk on rock; water-surface skating with a ripple; nymph jet pulse
examples: Crickets, water bugs, beetles, nymphs, fishing spiders, sea spiders

primitives: Radial: a lathed disc or ball with spines (urchin), five arms (star), a soft tube (cucumber), stubby legs (sea pig)
parameters: radius, arms (0/5), spine_length, tube (bool), legs (bool)
animation: Near-static; urchin spines twitch; sea pig plods; brittle stars writhe
examples: Urchins, crown-of-thorns, brittle stars, sand dollars, sea pigs, feather stars

for: Garden eels, sand eels, lampreys, tube-dwellers
primitives: A short anguilliform that lives half-hidden: only the front third is built when emerged
parameters: length, emerged_ratio, mouth (sucker/point)
animation: Rises from the sand, retracts in 0.15 s; lamprey attaches with a sucker ring
examples: Garden eel, sand eel, lamprey, silt lamprey, hagfish

primitives: A fusiform body with two wing quads (folded or spread), a beak, thin legs
parameters: length, wingspan, beak_length, tail_length
animation: Flapping in air; folded-wing torpedo dive underwater with a bubble trail
examples: Cormorant, cave swiftlet

primitives: Many small instanced bodies (krill, crickets, glowworms) or a mass (snapping shrimp colony, bone worms, glowworm threads)
parameters: body_count, body_plan_of_parts, spread_radius, light (bool)
animation: Instanced boids or a static mass with a shimmer
examples: Krill, crickets, glowworms, snapping shrimp, bone worms, sand hoppers

primitives: The species' base plan scaled up with extra detail: plate rows, barnacles, scars, multiple eyes or lures; separate rig parts for jaw, tail, fins, and lure
parameters: base_plan, scale, plate_rows, barnacle_density, scar_count, extra_parts (lure/claws/fluke)
animation: Slow, heavy: every motion has anticipation and overshoot; the jaw and tail are separate Chains
examples: The Goliath, the Lobster, the Matriarch, the Wyrm, the Leviathan, the Sand Worm
